about: Corrections applied by build_euclid.py on top of the AstroPix/ENSCI AVM WCS: east_as/north_as move the image on the sky (arcsec), scale multiplies the pixel scale by (1 + scale) about the tangent point, rotation_deg is added to the WTML Rotation. Measured 2026-11-14 by phase-correlating each tiled image (WCS rebuilt from its index_rel.wtml) with NASA SkyView DSS2 Red reprojected onto the same grid (>= 1"/px), then re-testing with the correction applied. ENSCI's AVM sits 2-4" north-west of DSS2. The WWT team's own placements of the six Euclid images already in the database differ from their AVM the same way (east 0.3-3.5", south 1.5-4.6"). The M78 control (euclid20240523c, retiled here, not delivered) measured east -1.3", north -3.9" against the database's +0.4", -4.1". The Q1 mosaics were fitted on a 3x3 grid of crops (each 20% of the field) with a similarity transform; the residuals listed are after correction. Smaller fields that DSS2 cannot constrain were registered to an overlapping, already-corrected Euclid image instead (see 'via'). Checker scripts: check_hips.py / fit_field.py (session scratchpad; see _HANDOFF.md).
